purpose: Game background and transparent sprite atlases

prompts.tetra: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: premium mobile coastal racing game sprite atlas, actual gameplay art. Square transparent 2x2 atlas of four separate matching miniature 3D assets. Top left: enormous pale limestone concrete tetrapod, upright central leg is a thick raised circular landing tip, 3 other heavy tapered arms radiate from the base. Top right: squat low wet basalt tetrapod with dark teal algae at its feet, smaller round central landing tip. Bottom left: weathered tetrapod with lush emerald slippery moss on sloping arms and a clean pale elevated circular top. Bottom right: large circular lighthouse sanctuary platform of warm weathered stone and bronze, four small floor inlays, one tiny glowing emerald lantern on rear rim. View all four from near overhead 65 degree camera angle, same camera and scale; central landing surface of each object located at exact center of each tile. Chunky confident silhouettes, beautifully detailed physically based stone pores, barnacles, wet surface highlights, golden late afternoon sun from upper left, cool teal reflected light, tactile premium adventure game art. Each object isolated in its quadrant with generous transparent margin, no cropped pieces, no background sea, no text, no UI, no grid lines. True transparent alpha background.
prompts.ocean: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: portrait mobile adventure game ocean floor background texture, 1024 by 1536 composition. Near overhead orthographic camera onto a deep teal coastal sea, absolutely no horizon. A broad playable water surface fills every edge, with luminous turquoise shallow reefs on the left, darker sapphire channel through the middle, submerged weathered limestone rubble and fine kelp on the right and far bottom, subtle sun-caustic ribbons and golden reflected light. Rich natural depth, cinematic miniature 3D adventure game environment, tactile photoreal detail with clean readable midtones. Restrained fine wavelets, not noisy or foamy all over. No above-water islands, no boats, no tetrapods, no platforms, no humans, no text, no border, no UI. Entire image water so separate gameplay sprites remain clearly visible. Beautiful emerald and petrol-blue water with warm sunlit shallow sand.
prompts.hide: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 2x2 transparent sprite atlas for an enchanted manor stealth game. Four distinct detailed miniature 3D game props, consistent orthographic near overhead 65 degree view and warm candlelit dark emerald/gold palette. Top left: an ancient waist-high bronze altar with a suspended emerald crystal, ornate ivy-covered stone base, tiny candle pair, readable green magical core. Top right: an open arched wrought-iron garden escape gate with two mossy stone pillars and warm gold lanterns, only gate and pillars with no wall. Bottom left: a round antique enchanted birdcage large enough to hold a tiny ghost, bronze bars, tiny teal glowing lock, small stone base. Bottom right: a friendly ghostly lavender smoke apparition hovering over an old wooden stool, a decoy prop dissolving into a curling smoke plume. Each sprite centered in its own equal quadrant with generous transparent padding, not touching adjacent objects; polished tactile materials, subtle local glowing accents, excellent silhouette. No room background, no cast ground plane, no text or numbers, no UI, no borders, true transparent background.
prompts.canal: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: portrait 2:3 mobile cooperative canal-defense game actual gameplay background. Premium beautifully lit miniature 3D diorama, near-overhead camera with subtle perspective. A wide clean turquoise irrigation reservoir occupies the central 70 percent and upper 70 percent of the image. FOUR huge ancient stone sluice gates are evenly spaced across the far TOP edge, releasing small distinct waterfalls into the reservoir. Mossy stone banks and tiny white flowers frame left and right edges; warm sun rays and restrained elegant water ripples. At the bottom quarter, a charming small Japanese rural watermill cottage with tiled roof sits on a circular raised stone island, with wooden crew docks around its left and right edges. Keep the WATER between upper gates and bottom cottage extremely open so many small enemy sprites can be drawn clearly. Deep green forest around edges, warm gold afternoon light, rich teal water, luminous polished fantasy adventure aesthetic, real stone and wood textures. No creatures, no characters, no text, no icons, no UI, no HUD, no decorative frame. Portrait composition.
